scope: Closed-world signed integer scalar and positional two-column tuple IN/NOT IN across independent physical outer/inner source bags, optionally with one correlated equality WHERE filter.

conditional.reason: Native cross-vendor session comparison laws lack independent execution
Non-integer typed or collation-dependent tuple comparison lacks portable exact equality evidence
Native DuckDB tuple IN applies NULL-sensitive behavior that differs from SQL standard fieldwise three-valued row equality when another component is a definite mismatch
conditional.reviewed_release_disposition: portable normative SQL TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN proven through independent DuckDB expanded fieldwise SQL oracle; native tuple IN behavior explicitly not certified
